findings.description: Erricolo, Danilo: ECE 'Professor' plus 'Adjunct Professor, Bioengineering' in another unit. Included as regular ECE on the primary professorial appointment; the Bioengineering adjunct title is outside ECE and is not coded as an excluded adjunct for ECE membership.

Killeen, Timothy L: 'Professor and President - University of Illinois system' on the ECE main list. Administrative title carrying professorial rank, included as regular per the brief's guidance; no conflicting official designation found.

Luican-Mayer, Adina: profile header lists both ECE and Department of Physics with a physics 'Secondary Contact'. No explicit joint/secondary EE/ECE appointment is stated; included as regular ECE on the official ECE listing. A reviewer may want to confirm no formal joint designation exists.
He, Lina: included as regular ECE Associate Professor; profile gives UIC Associate Professor 2025-present, recorded as effective_from year 2025.
Vital, Dieff: included as regular ECE Assistant Professor; profile gives explicit start 'August 2023', recorded as effective_from year-month 2023-08 (already past, so current).
Alonso, Matthew: clinical rank with an administrative 'Visiting Director' title; excluded as teaching. The 'Visiting' prefix is not a visiting faculty appointment.

All 45 listing entries on the primary faculty page (https://ece.uic.edu/faculty-and-staff/faculty/) enumerated and matched by name and profile slug to brief.people (45/45, no omissions in either direction). All 45 individual profile pages were also downloaded; each profile shows the same academic title as the listing. The listing has no section headings and no joint, courtesy, affiliate, visiting, emeritus or incoming designations.

Clinical titles (7 people: Abu Salah, Alonso, Caliskan, Jin, Kosmach, Revelo, Streeter) are coded excluded with category 'teaching' as the best-fit excluded category. The policy text does not define clinical rank; 'academic_professional' would also be excluded, so the decision is not affected.

Category pages linked from the Faculty navigation were also fetched as official directory pages: Emeritus Faculty (14 entries, all Emeritus/Emerita) and Adjunct Faculty (10 entries, including an introduction describing courtesy/dual positions). None of the 45 brief people appears on either page, so no person is omitted or double-counted. Coverage of those pages is not part of brief.lists.

No source failures: the required list page and all 45 profile pages were retrieved with curl exit 0 (GET, following redirects) and non-empty HTML bodies that contain the expected name and title. Emeritus and Adjunct pages were also retrieved successfully.
